contracts.claim: Every unauthenticated state projection is constrained by an explicit field allowlist.
Equivalent goal, mission, project, and metacognitive fields cannot leak through aliases or nesting.
Semantic scoring reads and computes only a bounded candidate set or indexed nearest neighbors.
Bounded retrieval preserves an approved relevance floor on reproducible datasets.
Embedding calls have independent call, token, and cost budgets with durable usage entries.
Timeouts and provider failures trip a bounded circuit without blocking recall or hiding fatigue cost.
A versioned keyring can read old segments through rotation and detect unrecoverable keys.
Verified cloud segments support read-through before bounded local garbage collection releases space.
Execution revision, result, artifact bytes, and evidence are joined by verified digests.
Each output type has an executable validator and no placeholder or model assertion can mark success.
Per-use approval is not advertised or accepted as a security boundary; new approval-required grants are rejected.
Legacy approval-required grants fail closed even with arbitrary tokens, while ordinary grant use remains atomic and auditable.
Workspace export starts at the selected subject storage key, never the shared workspace root.
Symlinks, reparse points, and renamed paths cannot include another subject's bytes.
Unknown reconciliation appends a revision while preserving the original behavior record.
The complete behavior revision sequence has stable hashes and export coverage.
Search and browser clients enforce streaming response limits before full buffering.
Every HTTP transport has bounded headers, body, time, redirects, and connection occupancy.
SMTP resolves and pins a public address and rejects rebinding and private destinations.
Delivery timeout becomes unknown and idempotent recovery cannot duplicate mail.
Unknown deliveries support provider-status lookup with durable evidence.
Manual reconciliation is authorized, append-only, and prevents unsafe resend decisions.
Disable and revoke invalidate already-built embedding providers before another call.
Failed embedding-secret deletion enters a bounded repair queue with health reporting.
Model and embedding custom endpoints pin public DNS across redirects and retries.
Embedding responses are streamed under hard body, time, and token bounds.
A package-id collision with different content is rejected before creating an import link.
Import provenance always binds the exact verified envelope, content hash, and signer.
Accepted common knowledge reaches cognition only through an advisory, non-private boundary.
Every read revalidates signature, trust status, revocation, and compatibility.
A newer schema marker is rejected before any schema or data write.
Each historical migration creates a verified backup and recovers from injected failure.
Thought-threshold observations map to think outcomes in formation and evaluation paths.
Simulation replays fixed history and compares workflow, budget, stagnation, and sleep effects.
Deadline consumption advances only during active execution, not queue, pause, block, or sleep.
Minimum duration and abandonment rules preserve the original bounded-project objective.
Multi-file outputs stage and validate completely before atomic manifest publication.
Platform-specific no-follow operations close symlink and reparse-point races.
Hot database and secret storage meet the documented at-rest threat model on both platforms.
